name: CloudUpdateTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the outbound call task
parameters.help_zh: 外呼任务Id
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task name. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format and cannot exceed 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码，长度小于50字
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The task description. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format and cannot exceed 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码，长度小于200字
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable scheduled start. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0. When the value is 1, the autoStartDay and autoStartTime parameters take effect, and at least one of them must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 定时开始；0.关闭 1.开启，默认关闭。值为1时autoStartDay和autoStartTime参数才生效，并且至少设置其中的一个
parameters.name: auto_start

parameters.help_en: The scheduled start date. This parameter takes effect only when autoStart is set to 1. If this parameter is not specified, the task starts at the time specified by autoStartTime on the current day. Format: yyyy-MM-dd, such as 2026-01-01
parameters.help_zh: 定时开始日期；autoStart=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在当天的autoStartTime定时启动。格式：yyyy-MM-dd，如：2026-01-01
parameters.name: auto_start_day

parameters.help_en: The scheduled start time. This parameter takes effect only when autoStart is set to 1. If this parameter is not specified, the task starts at 00:00:00 on the date specified by autoStartDay. Format: HH:mm:ss, such as 08:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 定时开始时间；autoStart=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在autoStartDay的00:00:00定时启动。格式：HH:mm:ss，如：08:00:00
parameters.name: auto_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable scheduled stop. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0. When the value is 1, the autoStopDay and autoStopTime parameters take effect, and at least one of them must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成；0.关闭 1.开启，默认关闭。值为1时autoStopDay和autoStopTime参数才生效，并且至少设置其中的一个
parameters.name: auto_stop

parameters.help_en: The scheduled stop date. This parameter takes effect only when autoStop is set to 1. If this parameter is not specified, the task stops at the time specified by autoStopTime on the current day. Format: yyyy-MM-dd, such as 2026-01-01
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成日期；autoStop=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在当天的autoStopTime定时完成。格式：yyyy-MM-dd，如：2026-01-01
parameters.name: auto_stop_day

parameters.help_en: The scheduled stop time. This parameter takes effect only when autoStop is set to 1. If this parameter is not specified, the task stops at 23:59:59 on the date specified by autoStopDay. Format: HH:mm:ss, such as 17:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成时间；autoStop=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在autoStopDay的23:59:59定时完成。格式：HH:mm:ss，如：17:00:00
parameters.name: auto_stop_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly end the task at the scheduled stop time. This parameter takes effect only when autoStop is set to 1. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0. When enabled, the task status is set to ended at the scheduled stop time regardless of whether all numbers in the task have been called. This is applicable to scenarios where call time restrictions apply to the data. Note: A task in the ended state cannot be started again
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成时强制结束任务；autoStop=1时生效。0.关闭 1.开启，默认关闭。开启配置后，当任务到定时完成时间时无论任务中的号码是否已经呼完，均将任务状态设置为结束。适用于对数据有呼叫时间限制的场景。注：任务在结束状态时无法再次启动
parameters.name: force_end_flag

parameters.help_en:
The auto task type. Valid values:

0: Continuous calling.
1: Interval calling.

Default value: 0. Use this parameter together with the scheduled start (autoStart) and scheduled stop (autoStop) parameters. Enable interval calling if the task needs to make calls only during specific time periods each day
parameters.help_zh: 0.连续呼叫 1.间隔呼叫，默认连续呼叫。配合定时开始（autoStart）和定时结束（autoStop）参数使用，如任务需要在每天的特定时间段内呼叫则开启间隔呼叫方式
parameters.name: auto_task_type

parameters.help_en: The interval calling time periods. This parameter is required when autoTaskType is set to 1. Specifies the time period configuration for calls. Format: time condition IDs. Multiple IDs are supported and separated by commas (,), such as 9,22. Note: You can obtain the time condition list by calling the query time condition settings list operation
parameters.help_zh: 间隔呼叫时间段；autoTaskType=1时必填。呼叫的时间段配置。参数格式：时间条件编号。支持多个，多个使用英文","逗号隔开，如：9,22。注：时间条件列表可通过查询时间条件设置列表接口获取
parameters.name: auto_trigger_time_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto complete. Valid values:

0: Disabled. After all numbers in the task are called, the task is automatically paused and the status is set to paused.
1: Enabled. After all numbers in the task are called, the task is automatically completed and the status is set to ended.

Default value: 1. Note: A task in the ended state cannot be started again
parameters.help_zh: 0.关闭 1.开启，默认开启。开启：任务中的号码呼叫完后，任务自动完成，状态设置为结束，关闭：任务中的号码呼叫完后，任务自动暂停，状态设置为暂停注：任务在结束状态时无法再次启动
parameters.name: auto_complete

parameters.help_en:
The retry policy.

Basic pattern: The data structure is in JSON format. ```{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}``` Format description: retry is the number of retries, round is the retry round number, and time is the retry interval for each round in the format of days-hours-minutes. For example, 1-1-1 means 1 day, 1 hour, and 1 minute.

Advanced pattern: Advanced pattern requires the number status identification service to be enabled. The data structure is in JSON array format. ```[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]``` Format description: condition is the conditional retry criterion, sort is the order of the conditional retry criterion, and the remaining fields are the same as in basic pattern.

Note: The system automatically identifies the pattern based on the parameter format. When retrying based on the first call time, the retry interval for each round must be greater than that of the previous round
parameters.help_zh: 重试策略；「基础模式」数据结构为Json格式```{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}```格式说明：retry是重试次数，round是第几次重试，time是第几次重试间隔的时间：1-1-1，第一个1是天，第二个1是小时，第三个1是分钟「高级模式」高级模式需要开启「号码状态识别」服务数据结构为JsonArray格式 ```[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]```格式说明：condition是重试条件，sort是重试条件的顺序，其余字段与基础模式一致 注：基础模式和高级模式的区分根据传入的参数格式自动识别。基于首次呼叫时间重试时，每轮的重试时间必须大于上一轮的时间
parameters.name: retry_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The time type for the retry strategy. This parameter takes effect when a retry strategy is configured. Valid values:

1: Based on the first call time.
2: Based on the last call time.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 重试策略时间类型；配置重试策略时生效。 1.基于首次呼叫时间 2.基于上次呼叫时间，默认基于首次呼叫时间
parameters.name: retry_strategy_time_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task is effective only on the current day. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled. Deletes both pending retry data and pending call data.
2: Enabled. Deletes only pending retry data.
3: Enabled. Deletes only pending call data.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 任务仅当天生效；0.关闭 1.开启，删除待重试的数据和待呼叫的数据 2.开启，删除待重试的数据 3.开启，删除待呼叫的数据，默认关闭
parameters.name: retry_strategy_only_today

parameters.help_en:
The call priority strategy. The data structure is in JSON format. ```{"strategy":[{"sort":1,"type":"retryCall", "desc":0},{"sort":2,"type":"firstCall","orderType":0}]}``` Format description: sort specifies the call order between retry numbers and uncalled numbers. type: retryCall for retry numbers, firstCall for uncalled numbers.

When type is retryCall, desc: 0 indicates that numbers with a smaller retry round number are called first (for example, round 1 and round 2 are called before later rounds). 1 indicates that numbers with a larger retry round number are called first (for example, round 5 and round 4 are called before earlier rounds).

When type is firstCall, orderType: 0 for sequential (by priority), 1 for random, 2 for sequential (by import time)
parameters.help_zh: 数据结构为Json格式```{"strategy":[{"sort":1,"type":"retryCall", "desc":0},{"sort":2,"type":"firstCall","orderType":0}]}```格式说明：sort是重试号码和未呼叫号码的呼叫顺序 type：retryCall重试号码、firstCall未呼叫号码当type=retryCall，desc：0.优先呼叫待重呼轮次数值较小的号码，即轮次靠前（如第1轮、第2轮）的号码先被呼叫 1.优先呼叫待重呼轮次数值较大的号码，即轮次靠后（如第5轮、第4轮）的号码先被呼叫当type=firstCall时，orderType：随机呼叫，0顺序(优先级) 1随机 2顺序(导入时间)
parameters.name: call_priority_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The type of the caller ID displayed to the customer. Valid values:

1: landline number.
2: mobile number.
4: number pool.
5: caller ID routing.

Note: We recommend that you use caller ID routing for flexible adjustment and control of caller ID strategies. Other types will be gradually deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码类型；1.外显固话 2.外显手机号 4.外显号码池 5.外显导航注：推荐使用外显导航，可以灵活调整和控制外显策略。其他类型将逐步下线
parameters.name: customer_clids_category

parameters.help_en: The list of caller IDs displayed to the customer. This parameter is required when customerClidsCategory is set to 1 or 2. Multiple values are supported and separated by commas (,). Not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码列表；customerClidsCategory=1或2时必填。支持多个，多个直接使用英文逗号','分隔。不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clids

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID selection rule for the customer side. This parameter takes effect when customerClidsCategory is set to 1 or 2. Valid values:

1: Random.
2: By area code.

Default value: 1. Not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显规则；customerClidsCategory=1或2时生效。1.随机 2.按区号，默认随机。不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The caller ID selection rule. This parameter takes effect when customerClidType is set to 2. The value is in JSON format and specifies the caller ID selection rule, such as default area code and whether to match the provincial capital. Example: {"defaultAreaCode":"010", "isMatchCapital":"1"}. Not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；customerClidType=2时生效。Json格式，外显号码选择规则：默认区号，是否匹配省会等；如：{"defaultAreaCode":"010", "isMatchCapital":"1"}。不建议使用
parameters.name: clid_property

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the caller ID weight configuration. This parameter takes effect when customerClidsCategory is set to 1. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.

Default value: 0. Not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码比例配置开关；customerClidsCategory=1时生效。0.关闭 1.开启，默认关闭。不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clid_weight_flag

parameters.help_en: The caller ID weight configuration. This parameter takes effect when customerClidsCategory is set to 1 and customerClidWeightFlag is set to 1. The value is in JSON array format: [{"number":"123,345","weight":"5"}, {"number":"567,789","weight":"5"}]. Not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码比例配置内容；customerClidsCategory=1且customerClidWeightFlag=1时生效。JsonArray格式 [{"number":"123,345","weight":"5"}, {"number":"567,789","weight":"5"}]，不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clid_weight

parameters.help_en: The name of the customer-side number pool or the caller ID routing identifier. This parameter is required when customerClidsCategory is set to 4 or 5. When customerClidsCategory is set to 4, pass the number pool name. When customerClidsCategory is set to 5, pass the caller ID routing identifier
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码池名称或外显导航标识；customerClidsCategory=4或5时必填。customerClidsCategory=4时customerClidsGroup传号码池名称。customerClidsCategory=5时customerClidsGroup传外显导航标识
parameters.name: customer_clids_group

parameters.help_en: The customer timeout period, in seconds. Default value: 30. Valid values: 5 to 60
parameters.help_zh: 客户超时时间；单位秒数，默认30秒，取值范围5 ~ 60
parameters.name: customer_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The call routing strategy. Valid values:

1: Direct agent connection. After the customer answers, an agent is directly assigned. If no idle agent is available, the call overflows to the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system (IVR configuration required), ensuring a direct connection experience for high-priority customers.
2: AI-to-agent transfer. After the customer connects, the call is first routed to the agent bot configured in the IVR. The system determines whether to transfer the call to an agent based on the interaction result, improving automation coverage and reducing labor costs
parameters.help_zh: 1.直连座席 2.AI转人工 直连座席模式：客户接听后直接分配座席，无空闲座席可溢出语音导航（需配置语音导航），保障高优先级客户直连体验 AI转人工：客户接入后，优先进入语音导航中配置的智能体机器人，按交互结果决定是否转接座席，提升自动化覆盖率，降低人工成本
parameters.name: call_route_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IVR. Specify either the ivrId or ivrName parameter. If both are specified, ivrId takes precedence. When creating an automatic outbound call node, either ivrId or ivrName is required.

Predictive outbound call scenarios: If no active agent is found within a specific period (2 seconds by default) after the customer answers, the call overflows to the IVR to continue queuing for an agent. The system also supports overflow to the IVR when an agent does not answer a transferred call. This requires the enterprise configuration to be enabled.

Automatic outbound call scenarios: The IVR to which the customer is transferred after answering
parameters.help_zh: 语音导航Id；参数ivrId和ivrName二选一，同时传入时ivrId生效，在创建自动外呼任务时ivrId或ivrName必选其一。预测外呼使用场景：如果客户接听后未在特定时间内（默认2秒）找到可用座席，通话将溢出到语音导航继续排队找座席。同时支持在呼转座席，座席未接听时也溢出到语音导航，需要开启企业配置生效自动外呼使用场景：客户接听后，转到的语音导航
parameters.name: ivr_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IVR. Specify either ivrId or ivrName. If both are specified, ivrId takes precedence. When creating an automatic outbound call task, either ivrId or ivrName is required
parameters.help_zh: 语音导航名称；参数ivrId和ivrName二选一，同时传入时ivrId生效，在创建自动外呼任务时ivrId或ivrName必选其一
parameters.name: ivr_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent calls at the task level. The actual concurrency does not exceed this limit. When type is set to 1, a value of 0 indicates no limit. Configure this parameter when the number of agents is fewer than 10
parameters.help_zh: 任务维度限制最大并发数，实际并发不会超过最大并发限制。type=1时，配置成0表示不限制，座席数量少于10时建议配置该参数
parameters.name: concurrency

parameters.help_en: The task custom fields. The value is in JSON array format. Each element in the array supports only one key-value pair. If multiple pairs are passed, only the first pair is used, such as {"key", "value"}. Default value: empty. Example: [{"name":"1234"},{"name1":"12345"}]. Note: The length of a single field value cannot exceed 1,000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 任务自定义字段。JsonArray格式；数组的每个元素只支持传递一组键值对，传递多组只取第一组，如 {"key", "value"}。 默认空值，示例：[{"name":"1234"},{"name1":"12345"}] 注：单个字段值的长度不能超过1000个字符
parameters.name: user_fields

parameters.help_en: The agent channel variables. The value is in JSON array format. A maximum of 5 variables are supported. Default value: empty. Example: [{"name":"abcdefg","value":"${cdr_enterprise_id}"}]. Note: The length of a single field value cannot exceed 1,000 characters. The variables are set to the agent-side channel as SIP headers
parameters.help_zh: 座席通道变量。JsonArray格式；最大支持5个变量。默认空值， 示例：[{"name":"abcdefg","value":"${cdr_enterprise_id}"}] 注：单个字段值的长度不能超过1000个字符。变量会以SIP_HEADER的形式设置到座席侧通道
parameters.name: call_variables

parameters.help_en: The call prohibition time periods during which calls are not allowed. Format: time condition IDs. Multiple IDs are supported and separated by commas (,), such as 9,22. Note: You can obtain the time condition list by calling the query time condition settings list operation
parameters.help_zh: 禁呼时间；在特定的时间段内禁止呼叫。参数格式：时间条件编号。支持多个，多个使用英文","逗号隔开，如：9,22。注：时间条件列表可通过查询时间条件设置列表接口获取
parameters.name: time_strategy

parameters.help_en: The list of agent IDs. This parameter is required when callGroupType is set to 1. Multiple agent IDs are supported and separated by commas (,). Note: An agent can belong to only one running task at a time
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号列表；callGroupType=1时必填。支持多个座席工号，多个之间使用英文逗号','分隔注：一个座席只能在一个运行中的任务中
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: The ID of the outbound call group. This parameter is required when callGroupType is set to 2. Note: An outbound call group can be bound to multiple tasks but can run in only one task at a time
parameters.help_zh: 外呼组号；callGroupType=2时必填。注：一个外呼组可以绑定到多个任务，但只能同时运行一个任务中
parameters.name: agent_group

parameters.help_en:
The agent allocation rule. Valid values:

1: Random.
2: Sequential.
3: Longest idle since last call (the total duration from the end of the last call to the current time).
4: Longest idle status duration (the duration since the agent last switched to the idle state).

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 座席分配规则；1.随机 2.顺序 3.座席未进线最大时（从上一次呼叫结束到当前的总时长） 4.座席状态[空闲]最长时长（座席最近一次切换为空闲状态的持续时长），默认随机
parameters.name: call_strategy

parameters.help_en: The agent timeout period, in seconds. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5 to 60
parameters.help_zh: 座席超时时间；单位秒数，默认10秒，取值范围5 ~ 60
parameters.name: agent_timeout

parameters.help_en: The agent wrap-up time. Default value: 30 seconds. Valid values: 1 to 10800. The wrap-up time affects the number of calls per round. A larger value reduces the number of dialed numbers
parameters.help_zh: 座席整理时间；默认30秒，取值范围1～10800，整理时间会影响每次呼叫的个数，值越大，呼叫号码个数会减小
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en: The maximum agent wait time. Default value: 40 seconds. Minimum value: 10. Maximum value: 600. The maximum idle time allowed for agents. During task execution, if the average agent idle time exceeds MaxWaitTime, the number of calls per round increases
parameters.help_zh: 座席最长等待时间；默认40秒，最小10，最大600，允许座席空闲的最大时间。任务执行过程中，如果座席平均空闲时间大于maxWaitTime，每次呼叫个数会增加
parameters.name: max_wait_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of available agents. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 10. If the number of available agents in the task is less than this value, the task is automatically paused to avoid harassment
parameters.help_zh: 最小可用座席数；默认为10，取值范围1 ~ 10。任务内可用座席数小于当前值时，任务自动暂停，避免骚扰
parameters.name: min_available_agent_count

parameters.help_en: The harassment rate. Default value: 1. Valid values: greater than 0 and less than or equal to 20. Decimal values are supported with up to two decimal places. A smaller value reduces the number of dialed numbers. A larger value increases the number of dialed numbers and improves agent utilization
parameters.help_zh: 骚扰率；默认值为1，取值范围为大于0，小于等于20，支持小数，精确到小数点两位。值越小呼叫的号码越少，值越大呼叫的号码越多，座席利用率越高
parameters.name: quotiety

parameters.help_en: The over-dial rate. Default value: 100. Valid values: 50 to 400
parameters.help_zh: 超呼率；默认值为100，取值范围50～400
parameters.name: predict_adjust

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of calls an agent can answer per day. For more information, see the description below. JsonArray format: [{"cnos":["2000","2001"],"limit":"5"}]. Note: To use the daily answer limit feature for agents, enable the enterprise configuration. The system starts counting daily answered calls only after the feature is enabled and the limit is configured
parameters.help_zh: 座席当日接听的通话个数上限，使用方式详见下方说明；JsonArray格式 [{"cnos":["2000","2001"],"limit":"5"}] 注：使用座席当日接听数限制功能需开启企业配置，功能开启并且配置上限后系统才开始统计当日接听数
parameters.name: call_limit_strategy

parameters.help_en: The customer-side hold music. The audio played to the customer while waiting for an agent to answer after the customer picks up. Default value: silent tone. Public and enterprise audio files are supported. The value is the path of the audio file, such as 60000011533526918819
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧等待音；客户接听后呼叫座席，等待座席接听时播放的语音，默认为空白音。支持公共语音和企业语音，值为语音文件的path，如:60000011533526918819
parameters.name: customer_moh

parameters.help_en: The customer-side prompt tone. The audio played to the customer after the customer picks up and before the call is transferred to an agent. The system searches for an agent only after the prompt finishes playing. Default value: no prompt. Public and enterprise audio files are supported. The value is the path of the audio file, such as 60000011533526918819
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧提示音；客户接听后呼转座席前播放的语音，提示音播放完成后再找座席，默认无提示音。支持公共语音和企业语音，值为语音文件的path，如:60000011533526918819
parameters.name: customer_voice

parameters.help_en: The initial estimated customer answer rate. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 100. During the warm-up phase, the call frequency is calculated based on this answer rate
parameters.help_zh: 初始化预计客户接通率；默认50，取值范围1～100，预热阶段的呼叫，按照此接通率计算呼叫频率
parameters.name: answer_rate

parameters.help_en: The task warm-up duration. Default value: 300 seconds. Valid values: 60 to 600
parameters.help_zh: 任务预热时间；默认300秒, 取值范围60 ～ 600
parameters.name: warm_up_duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to re-warm-up after the task is paused. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled). Default value: 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 暂停后重新预热；0.关闭，1开启，默认开启，任务暂停后是否需要重新预热
parameters.name: is_rewarm
